videos.clip.6fqlzRvmrwo.title: Flap Discs Factory Direct — Custom Specs, Large Stock, Consistent Performance
videos.clip.6fqlzRvmrwo.body: A fifteen-second look at MoTai flap discs: a consistent flap arrangement for a steady cut and long life, custom sizes, grits and backing plates available, and large stock ready for fast bulk shipment. The discs are built for metal grinding and weld blending, rust and paint removal, and stainless-steel fabrication, and run on angle grinders.

videos.clip.paQ16Aq0F3g.title: Automated Precision Cutting — How Our Sanding Belts Are Made
videos.clip.paQ16Aq0F3g.body: A seventeen-second pass through our automated belt cutting. Wide zirconia abrasive roll stock is fed in, the machine is set up via the touch control panel, and the cloth is slit and shaped to your exact dimensions, then each finished width is measured and verified before the belt is assembled. The result is a consistent finished sanding belt for wood, metal and composites.
